info.title: Tingyue Backend API
info.description: Authoritative API contract api-contract-v2.9.0. JSON fields use camelCase and timestamps use UTC RFC 3339. Clients branch on stable error.code values, never human messages. Ranking v2 uses unlimited decimal-string learning points; progress/word mutation protocols stay unchanged.

servers.description: Test placeholder; replace after domain approval

200.description: API process is alive.
All required dependencies are ready.

503.description: At least one required dependency is unavailable.

201.description: Session created. The login code and returned refresh token must never be logged.

200.description: Refresh token rotated and a new token pair issued.
Current session revoked. Repeating the same request is safe.
Current business user and trusted profile fields. Clients gate optional sync features using the contract-version response header.

post.description: Account-scoped favorites and recent opening observations. Favorites use revisioned deletion tombstones: a stale favorite cannot resurrect an unfavorite. Open times merge monotonically and future client clocks clamp to serverTime. These actions do not earn learning points. Retry the immutable batch with the same batchId; every new pull must use a fresh batchId even when its cursor has not advanced.

200.description: Idempotent operation acknowledgements and paginated changes, including unfavorite tombstones.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Literal case-insensitive title, author, series or internal content number search.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Available means currently published free digital content, not physical copy stock.

200.description: Visible works in stable cursor order.

get.description: Current published works with version-aligned metadata and signed covers; cursors bind the search and category. New published works appear without a client rebuild.

200.description: Work and piece metadata.

parameters.name: contentVersion
parameters.description: Omit for the current published version.

200.description: Immutable versioned manifest with short-lived asset URLs and SHA-256 checksums.

post.description: Explicit one-time import of allowlisted local learning evidence. Idempotency identity is userId plus snapshotId; the Idempotency-Key must equal snapshotId. Server recomputes progress completion and Quiz scores. Word surfaces remain pending candidates until stable vocabulary identities exist.

200.description: Per-item import receipt. Exact duplicate snapshots return the original receipt with duplicate=true.

get.description: Returns current-version authoritative progress in stable piece order. Historical content versions are retained but omitted.

200.description: A page of current-version progress.
Current-version authoritative progress, including an empty revision 0 state when no evidence exists.

put.description: Merges trusted listened ranges for one immutable content version. A stale base revision may add ranges but cannot replace the authoritative checkpoint.

200.description: Idempotent merge receipt and complete authoritative state.

post.description: Bidirectional stable saved-word sync. Deletions are revisioned tombstones. A stale delete wins over an active record, while a stale save cannot resurrect a tombstone. Restoring a deleted word requires an explicit save based on the current revision. Client timestamps never order conflicts. v2.1 clients use a fresh optional pullNonce for each new pull and retain it with the immutable batch on retries; older clients may omit it. Cursor changes are ordered by numeric sequence.

200.description: Per-operation merge decisions plus authoritative saved-word changes and deletion tombstones after the signed cursor.

post.description: Idempotency identity is userId plus attemptId. Client-provided score, mastery and ranking are forbidden by the request schema.

200.description: Server-verified score or stable rejected result. Exact duplicate attempts return the original result.
Confirmed learning points and component breakdown.

parameters.name: periodKey
parameters.description: Required for week and month; values come from ranking-options.

200.description: Immutable ranking snapshot ordered by a server-computed 0-1000 Quiz score. The score combines cohort percentiles for distinct completed books, verified reading volume, Bayesian-adjusted accuracy, challenge, growth and breadth. The exact formula and tie rule are identified by ruleVersion.

get.description: Returns the score breakdown and server-verified per-book Quiz facts behind one visible ranking participant. It never returns answers or a real-name field.

parameters.name: snapshotId
parameters.description: Pin the detail to the snapshotId returned by the ranking list. A cursor must reference the same snapshot.

200.description: Algorithm score breakdown and paginated Quiz book records from the same immutable ranking snapshot.

post.description: Creates only control-plane metadata. File bytes are uploaded directly to object storage. Subtitle input supports normalized JSON (8 MiB) or UTF-8 VTT/SRT (100 MiB); Worker preserves the original and produces bounded narration-oriented JSON. Published manifests describe the derived bytes, not source hashes. Conversion does not approve publication or infer contextual vocabulary.

200.description: Authorized ingestion operations response.
Batch, item and processing status without presigned URLs or sensitive payloads.

201.description: Short-lived multipart upload session. URLs are never written to ordinary logs.

post.description: Atomically changes the published manifest only after all technical and human review gates are satisfied.

200.description: Server-authoritative campus, period, grade and reading-level options. Week and month options drive the fourth selector in the client.

get.description: Authenticated lifetime confirmed learning points; each earned fact counts once, without a cap.
Account-scoped revision deltas including withdrawals. Cursors bind user and database epoch; invalid cursors require an atomic full repull.

200.description: Account-scoped revision deltas including withdrawals. Cursors bind user and database epoch; invalid cursors require an atomic full repull.

get.description: Server-verified statistics: first-completion pieces and version-specific words; deduplicated effective listening. Quiz averages/trends use the latest verified, nonwithdrawn, currently compatible attempt per piece ordered by server verification time. Unknown words are null; integer totals remain decimal strings.

200.description: Server-verified statistics: first-completion pieces and version-specific words; deduplicated effective listening. Quiz averages/trends use the latest verified, nonwithdrawn, currently compatible attempt per piece ordered by server verification time. Unknown words are null; integer totals remain decimal strings.

get.description: Immutable same-snapshot Quiz analysis. Statistics use the latest server-verified attempt per piece; PASSED uses stored mastery, not the ranking metric. Search and sorting apply to all attempt records, not the aggregate statistics. Confirmation time is server verified_at. No answers, user ID or real-name fields.

post.description: Explicit immutable plan; at most 100 works, 1000 chapters, 100 GiB of declarations, 8 MiB JSON body. Active administrator is rechecked after catalog locks. Atomic draft catalog, per-chapter batches and audit. Existing attributes must match; any historical chapter/version requires a new version. Actor-bound idempotency. No automatic upload, processing, rights approval or publication.

201.description: Authorized bulk import control-plane response. No approval or publication.

get.description: Most recent 20 administrator-shared groups only. Not a paginated archive; older groups can be retrieved by ID. Query fields are rejected.

200.description: Authorized bulk import control-plane response. No approval or publication.

get.description: Immutable original plan with current ordered chapter batch status. Current status is not a historical snapshot.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token. Tokens must not be logged.

ContractVersion.description: Authoritative API contract implemented by this server instance.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key unique to one logical mutation. Reusing it with a different request body returns IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding page.

BadRequest.description: Malformed request, invalid ranking period or invalid filter.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed, expired or was revoked.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated identity lacks the required permission or content access.

NotFound.description: Business resource not found or not visible.

Unprocessable.description: Checksum, subtitle or processing validation failed.

InternalError.description: Internal details are suppressed from the response.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required dependency, ranking snapshot or service is unavailable.

AdminAction.description: Idempotent administrative action accepted or completed.
